clauses.text:
EXECUTIVE ORDER 9610
Authorizing the A dministrator of V et­
erans’ Affairs T o A cquire and D ispose 
of P roperty
WHEREAS the Veterans’  Administra­
tion is declared by section 100 of the 
Servicemen’ s Readjustment Act of 1944 
(58 Stat. 284) as amended by Public Law 
138, 79th Congress, approved July 6, 
1945, to be an essential war agency; and 
WHEREAS I find that there exists an 
acute shortage of space of the type re­
quired by the Veterans’  Administration 
to perform the essential war-agency 
functions which the Veterans’  Adminis­
tration is authorized and directed by 
law to perform:
NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the 
authority vested in me by Title II of the 
Second War Powers Act, 1942, approved 
March 27, 1942 (56 Stat. 177), the Ad­
ministrator of Veterans’  Affairs, or any 
officer of the Veterans’  Administration 
acting in behalf, of the Administrator 
during his absence or disability, is hereby 
authorized to exercise the authority con­
tained in the said Title II of the Second 
War Powers Act, 1942, to acquire, use, 
and dispose of any real property, tem­
porary use thereof, or other in£erest 
therein, together with any personal 
property located thereon, or used there­
with, that shall be deemed necessary for 
military, naval, or other war purposes.
